Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the description of his worship, add his inner feeling, for example: “孟子觉得祭拜很有趣。”
2. At the classmates’ reaction, show their teasing through dialogue, for example: “同学们笑着说：‘你每天只会祭拜吗？’”
3. When his mother notices the influence, add her worry and thought, for example: “妈妈很着急，心想：‘这样会影响孟子。’”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple feeling that fits his repeated interest in the ritual.
It gives a concrete, level-appropriate example of the classmates teasing him.
The learner already says that his mother sees the classmates’ bad influence on him.
